description: React component for rendering a draggable, collapsible, fullscreen-able summary view of Kanban columns and cards, with localStorage persistence and dynamic layout adjustments.

methods.name: toggleCollapsed
methods.description: Toggles the collapsed state of a column by its ID.

methods.name: moveColumn
methods.description: Reorders columns based on drag-and-drop indices.

methods.name: computeScale
methods.description: Calculates scale factor for fullscreen layout based on column count.

methods.name: getStatusDotColor
methods.description: Returns color code for card status dots.

methods.name: getStatusClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class for card status background color.
